# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 095

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 2350–2374, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example individually. I rewrote all 25 gloss/example pairs in natural Hindi. Several examples had drifted to another sense or context, especially `stake`, `possession`, `tale`, `pot`, and `cow`; these were aligned with the English source.

Changed: 25 Hindi gloss/example pairs.

Progress: 2,375/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (26.87%); 6,462 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
